peer_id_prefix: first 8 hex bytes / 16 chars of peer substrate-ID

peer_event_node_type.semantics: Inner node_type. Subject to L2/FEDERATION §9.4 allowlist and §11 recursive validation.

peer_event_parent_hashes.semantics: Peer-side parents. Provenance ONLY — not wrapper parents.

peer_event_original_hash.semantics: BLAKE3 merkle_hash(parent_hashes, content_canonical_bytes); proves exact event seen.

parent_rule_security_critical: Wrapper parent = THIS substrate's local DAG tip at ingest. NEVER peer's parent_hashes. Cross-chain merge is banned.
idempotency: Re-pull produces identical wrapper (deterministic fields + canonical-bytes); DAG insert_node content-hash idempotent.
